title: Player views rating history
description: Open history for one member from the Players list. With no opponents selected, History shows that player’s full rating timeline. Selecting opponents instead shows match history against those players.

steps.title: Players list
steps.body: Tutorial PlayerOnly has rating changes from the seeded completed Round Robin — a clear one-player history example.

steps.title: Open history for the player
steps.body: Tap the scroll icon on the player’s row. That starts history selection with the player chosen (and opponents pre-selected for match history).
steps.actionHint: Click the history icon on the player row

steps.title: History selection
steps.body: The toolbar shows the selected player and how many opponents are checked. Match history uses opponents; rating history needs none.
steps.resultNote: History selection mode is active with the player selected.

steps.title: Clear opponents for rating history
steps.body: Deselect All removes opponents so View History opens the full rating timeline for this one player only.

steps.title: One player, no opponents
steps.body: With 0 opponents selected, View History will show Rating History rather than head-to-head matches.
steps.resultNote: Opponent count is 0 — ready for one-player rating history.

steps.title: View History
steps.body: Confirm to open the Rating History page for the selected member.

steps.title: Rating History
steps.body: Full Rating History lists rating events (newest first), including the completed Round Robin adjustment for this player.
steps.resultNote: Rating History page shows the selected player’s timeline.
